answer: Make shared control a liability anyone can cash in. If someone presents signatures from two identity keys over one claim message, those identities are proven to share an owner, and their locked rewards go half to the claimant, half burned; openly declared links are exempt. An honest agent holds one key and risks nothing. A hidden farm must guard its whole atlas of keys forever: any leaked backup, contractor or buyer of an aged account can dive like a falcon on the pooled nectar. Renting out identities stops being safe, since the seller always keeps a copy of the key.
